summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist per the spec. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (loader plus private helpers _resolve_path and _resolve_field, stdlib only), an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" tilde-underlined autofunction subsection in docs/source/data.rst after Utilities, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist and four tests. Extra ValueError guards beyond the spec: a non-list value under the data_list_key, and a non-mapping top-level JSON. Verification was by reading only: no tests, black, or flake8 were run, and awk found no line over 120 columns in the new or edited Python files after one fix. Nothing is committed.
